inputs.name: ticks

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: highway-v0 is registered with the gym entry point bark_ml.environments.gym:ContinuousHighwayGym
ContinuousHighwayGym builds the runtime with render=True
SingleAgentRuntime.reset and step call render when the runtime was built with render=True
The continuous highway behavior model takes the steering rate and the acceleration as its action
The continuous action space is BoundedContinuous(2) over acceleration and steering rate, with the default lower bound [-5.0, -0.2] and upper bound [4.0, 0.2]
The highway blueprint uses a 0.2 s simulation step
The highway blueprint builds four lane corridors, marks lane 2 as the controlled ego lane, places the ego agent between s 40 and 80 and other agents between s 0 and 250
The highway scenario is a curved four-lane road whose vehicles are controlled by the intelligent driver model (IDM)
The nearest observer defaults to four nearest agents and concatenates six ego values plus four values per agent, 22 values in total
The ego block is normalized s, d, theta, longitudinal velocity and lateral velocity, followed by the raw lane-corridor index
The observer declares its observation space as a Box over observation_len_ values with low 0 and high 1
The default step-count evaluator terminates an episode after more than 220 steps
SingleAgentRuntime.reset takes only a scenario and returns the observer's observation
SingleAgentRuntime.step advances the world by its fixed step time and returns observation, reward, done and info
The continuous highway blueprint's scenario generator uses random_seed 0 by default

determinism.notes: the upstream environment has no seed parameter: SingleAgentRuntime.reset takes a scenario instead, and the scenario generator is configured with random_seed 0; the fake always starts the same fixed episode and ignores the bridge's seed, so cap.world.seed.v1 is accepted but does not change a trajectory

gaps: the fake is a kinematic stand-in: it integrates acceleration and steering rate on a straight lane and does not model BARK's round road, lane geometry, IDM/MOBIL traffic, collisions, the goal polygon or the reward-shaping evaluator

the observation uses the 22-value NearestObserver layout, but the four other-agent blocks are static placeholders and the raw lane index is put in the sixth element as the upstream observer does, although the declared Box is [0, 1]
the fake starts the ego at rest, ends an episode after the upstream default of 221 steps or after a placeholder lane departure, and ignores reset seeds and reset options
no rendering: the upstream ContinuousHighwayGym always constructs the viewer and renders on reset and step, so its real backend needs a display
the sim backend was not run: bark-ml needs the compiled bark-simulator package, gym, the environment registration import and a display; this package was checked on its fake backend only
snapshot and restore are not offered: SingleAgentRuntime exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation stays readable
